sentences.text: The Oahr scheme is designed to provide financial assistance to farmers in India.
It aims to enhance the income of farmers by providing them with a safety net during adverse conditions.
The benefits include direct cash transfers to eligible farmers to support their agricultural activities.
Eligibility is generally limited to small and marginal farmers as defined by government criteria.
Farmers must provide necessary documentation to prove their status and eligibility for the scheme.
The application process typically involves online registration through the official government portal.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare.
Assistance is provided on a periodic basis depending on the agricultural cycle and specific conditions.
The scheme may also include provisions for additional support in the form of training or resources.
Further details can be accessed through the official government website or local agricultural offices.
